title: Noise-Robust Quantum-Inspired Synthetic Minority Oversampling for Condition Monitoring and Fault Classification in Industrial and Energy Systems
summary: Class imbalance remains a major challenge in industrial condition monitoring and fault classification, where minority fault patterns can be poorly represented during machine learning. This work develops a noise-aware quantum-inspired oversampling framework and systematically evaluates its effectiveness and robustness for industrial and energy-system fault diagnosis.
